source.title: Thread (Korean): a provider named constructor became an Object function string, the alias lookup fixed in PR #772

reason: A three-post Korean explainer of the model attribution bug fixed in SlopDotCash/slopdotcash#772: a plain PROVIDER_ALIASES[name] lookup returned the inherited Object constructor for a provider literally named constructor, so the models summary showed a function string. It shows the Object.hasOwn fix, the cases checked (constructor, Constructor, existing OpenAI and Z.ai aliases, unregistered names) and says the change is metadata only, not model performance. A worked example of the prototype-key pitfall for contributors who map names with plain objects; separate from the merged PR, which already scored on its own.
